UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE, Plaintiff, v. KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6, Defendants. ____________________________________/ | Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

[PROPOSED] ALTERNATIVE ORDER OF REFERRAL

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion Under Rule 26(d)(1) for Present Authorization to Serve Two Interrogatories on Meta Concerning Plaintiff’s Full Legal Name and Facebook Account (the “Motion”). It is hereby

ORDERED that the Motion is REFERRED to the United States Magistrate Judge for determination; it is further

ORDERED that the referral expressly authorizes the Magistrate Judge to determine whether to grant, under Rule 26(d)(1) and as an express and limited exception to the discovery posture described in ECF No. 108, authorization to serve the two interrogatories in Exhibit A — Meta — November 7, 2026 — Final before the Rule 26(f) conference, including the timing of service and any response period; it is further

ORDERED that this referral decides nothing concerning the authorization itself, which remains for determination on the referred Motion.

Alexandria, Virginia

__________, 2026

______________________________

United States District Judge
